narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Scorebook"**

The page is a baseball scorebook being kept, and the thing it keeps is the proof. The material is buff card stock; everything the printer put on the card (headings, column heads, rules, tables, diagrams, the MLB number) is one teal ink; everything the engine writes (outs, runners, Bend's number, the running note, "proven") is graphite pencil in a handwriting face; and one red pencil marks the play happening now. There is no second surface. Depth is a thicker rule or a tint of the same ink, never a card, a shadow, or a radius.

Density is a filled-in card's: tight 1px-ruled tables, 84×64 cells, 8–14px gaps, 72ch measure for printed instructions. The printed voice is condensed, uppercase, letterspaced; the pencilled voice is large, loose, and never used for anything the printer would have set. Pele diagrams are themed to print in the same teal on the same stock with graphite highlights, so the figures read as part of the card rather than as embedded screenshots. The rejected arrangement is the engine showcase: headline, stat cards, glowing chart, dark mode, code block as hero.
keyCharacteristics: One material (buff stock) and three marks on it: teal print, graphite pencil, red pencil.
Printed vs pencilled is a semantic distinction: the face tells you who wrote the value.
Rules carry all structure: 3px (page edge), 2px (section head), 1px solid (row/header), 1px at 55% (interior grid).
No radius, no shadows, no cards, no dark theme; `color-scheme: light` is declared.
Tabular figures everywhere (`font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` on body).

rules.name: The Three Marks Rule
rules.body: Every colour on the page is one of three marks on the stock: teal print, graphite pencil, red pencil. There is no fourth ink; tints and alpha rules are strengths of teal, never new hues.

rules.name: The Red Pencil Rule
rules.body: Red marks only what is happening now or what is wrong now (latest play, live inning, stale feed, focus). It never decorates, never fills a surface larger than a 2px stroke, and never appears on the printed back of the card except as focus.

rules.name: The Printed/Pencilled Rule
rules.body: If the printer could have known it before the game, it is teal in Archivo Narrow; if the keeper wrote it during the game, it is graphite in Caveat. MLB's number is printed; Bend's is pencilled.

rules.name: The Keeper's Hand Rule
rules.body: Caveat is used only for what a scorekeeper would write by hand during the game: outs, runs, the win number, the running note, "proven", the step numerals. Never for headings, labels, links, prose, or anything the printer set.

rules.name: The Condensed Print Rule
rules.body: Anything printed on the card as structure (headings, column heads, labels, navigation, buttons, footer) is Archivo Narrow 700, uppercase, letterspaced 0.06–0.1em. Running prose is Archivo 400 at 15px, never condensed.

rules.name: The No Shadow Rule
rules.body: Nothing on the card floats. If a surface needs separation, give it a rule or a tint of the ink; never a drop shadow, blur, or lifted hover.

rules.name: The Rule Weight Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy of separation is rule weight: 3px for the page edge (masthead top, footer top), 2px for a section head, 1px solid for rows and frames, 1px at 55% alpha for interior cells.

dos: Do set every printed structural label in Archivo Narrow 700 uppercase with 0.06–0.1em tracking in teal (`print`).
Do use Caveat only for values a scorekeeper writes during the game, in graphite, at 17px or larger (The Keeper's Hand Rule).
Do separate with rules: 3px page edge, 2px section head, 1px row, 1px at 55% interior (The Rule Weight Rule).
Do keep red to the latest play, the live inning, the stale feed, the selected-tab underline and focus (The Red Pencil Rule).
Do theme every Pele diagram through `.pele { --pele-* }` so it prints in teal on the stock with graphite highlights.
Do keep `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` and right-align numeric columns.
Do keep prose at 72ch and footnotes at 90ch.
donts: Don't add a radius to any box; the only round form is the pencilled out circle (The No Shadow Rule covers lift; Shapes covers corners).
Don't add box-shadows, blurs, cards, or raised surfaces; depth is rule weight and 9% tint.
Don't introduce a dark theme or a second stock colour beyond `stock-deep` on tab hover; `color-scheme: light` is declared.
Don't introduce a fourth hue; every colour is a strength of teal, graphite, or red on buff.
Don't set headings, labels, links or prose in Caveat, or set the pencilled Bend number in a printed face.
Don't render a diagram or chart with anything other than Pele.
